bullets.text: Fractile's £100m Boost - **Fractile** expands UK operations with a £100 million investment, enhancing the AI hardware ecosystem.
AI-RRM Enhances Wi-Fi 7 - **AI-RRM** optimizes Wi-Fi 7 networks for better performance and stability in dense environments.
WPA3 Security Challenges - **WPA3** adoption faces hurdles in multi-dwelling units due to inconsistent implementations.
UK's 5G SA Investment Review - The UK government seeks industry input to support **5G SA** deployment by 2030.
Vodafone's Private 5G Expansion - **Vodafone** reports 173 private 5G networks across 20 countries, targeting SMEs.
Samsung's AI-Ready Networks - **Samsung** promotes virtualized infrastructure to support AI workloads and reduce costs.
Amazon Leo's Maritime Push - **Amazon Leo** expands satellite services to maritime sectors, enhancing global ocean coverage.
GreenMed Subsea Cable Project - **Sparkle** announces the GreenMed subsea cable to enhance connectivity between Europe and the Middle East.
Ericsson Validates 5G Slicing - **Ericsson**, **FET**, and **OPPO** confirm performance-based connectivity through 5G slicing.
BT Group Leadership Changes - **BT Group** announces executive shifts at Openreach and BT International to enhance operations.
